title: angelica aquilegiifolia
intro: Angelica aquilegiifolia, commonly known as American Angelica or Wild Celery, is a perennial herb that belongs to the carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in relieving digestive issues, fever reduction, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of American Angelica include its use as a diuretic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory agent, which can help to reduce swelling and ease pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
